title: Quality of Laik
description: Adds a lot of quality of life changes to as much of the game through datapacks as possible!
body:
Gives various quality of life changes to almost every aspect of the game that is possible through datapacks! This will be updated once per year to include all of the drops.

## Features:
- Stonecutter lists for every wood set
- All stair blocks used in the stonecutter can be cut into a single slab
- Deepslate set of blocks have been reworked to match more with its stone counterpart in that mining deepslate with silk touch will now have recipes attached to it
- Renewable pottery sherd recipe (you need a sherd to dupe it)
- Colored blocks like concrete powder, concrete, wool, carpet, stained glass, banners, etc can all changed from one to the other (like from red to blue and back to blue instead of needing normal glass to stain them)
- Crafting recipe outputs make more sense overall (stairs as an example)
- Any recipe that usees stone or cobblestone can now use their equivalent stone variants
- Glass and enderchests can be broken without silk touch and you'll get the block back
- Minecarts and all track recipes use copper instead of iron and gold
- Dispenser uses string instead of a bow
- A lot of uncraftable items can now be crafted and some items can be transferred between each other
- Some recipe advancements make more sense
- Some mob loot tables have been adjusted to give more reason to kill the mobs but still keeping the incentives to keep them alive
- Various structure bugs have been fixed
- axolotls can be fed with either a tropical fish in a bucket or just a tropical fish
### AND MORE!!
